observations.title: Register and log into an offline server
observations.player_action: On first registration use login with the password repeated; later use login with one password. The documented l alias is available.
observations.outcome: The server authenticates the session through chat commands.
conditions: External documentation is not installed-runtime proof; inspect the installed artifact/configuration before relying on defaults or exact compatibility.

observations.title: Wait for authentication before gameplay actions
observations.player_action: Join and complete authentication before movement, chat, attack or container interaction.
observations.outcome: The fail-closed gate blocks ordinary actions until login without moving the player to a separate lobby.
